text:
Maria (CS): quick debrief from today's onboarding calls — three customers mentioned gaps that look like product asks, thought we should capture and score them before next roadmap sync
Sam (Product): thanks, can you paste the quick notes here? are any of these blocking renewals?
Maria (CS): short list — Brightlane: per-route billing visibility (customer needs cost per-route to reconcile invoicing). Evergreen Health: model outranks for specific doc types (accuracy drop on clinical notes). NimbusOps: private deployment telemetry + KMS integration (security/regulatory ask).
Noah (AE): Brightlane flagged renewal as "high friction" — renewal conversation in 4 wks, health score dropped ~20%. Evergreen is medium risk, asked for a POC. NimbusOps is expansion ask but may impact procurement timeline.
Lee (PM): useful — can we add one-line impact + ask severity for each (low/med/high) and whether it's a blocker? I'll run a quick triage and slot into today
Maria (CS): adding severity inline: Brightlane — HIGH (blocking renewal unless we show per-route export), Evergreen Health — MED (affects accuracy SLA, willing to trial patch), NimbusOps — LOW->MED (security ask but long procurement).
Ava (Support): pasted a short transcript snippet from Brightlane support ticket — shows customer confusion about route attribution.
Ava (Support): ```
Customer: "We can't reconcile the invoice to usage, the routes are lumped."
Support: "Can you share request ids?"
Customer: "We just need per-route breakdown or we'll have to pause usage billing dispute."
```
Sam (Product): ok — priority framework suggestion: (1) renewal risk (2) user impact (3) dev effort. Proposed quick scores: Brightlane 9/10 (renewal risk + moderate effort), Evergreen 6/10 (impact on accuracy + higher effort), NimbusOps 4/10. Thoughts?
Lee (PM): agree. Sam, can you create a short spike ticket for Brightlane per-route export with acceptance criteria? Use template: `Customer, Ask, Acceptance Criteria, Owner, Est (T-shirt)`
Sam (Product): will do, creating ticket now. I'll link back here. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): I'll schedule 3 follow-up calls (Brightlane, Evergreen, NimbusOps) to collect exact sequences and artifacts. Also will surface Brightlane to RevOps for billing workarounds.
feedback-bot: Summary doc created -> https://redwood-internal/docs/cs/voices/1757723456 (auto)
Noah (AE): thanks team — keeping an eye on Brightlane renewal. Ping me if we need to escalate to AE leader.
Sam (Product): created ticket #RD-11234 and linked transcript + that convo. Will aim for a 1-week spike and then recommend next steps.
Maria (CS): perfect, closing loop here. follow-ups scheduled, will drop brief notes in the doc after each call. :white_check_mark:
